body.en: The average woman waits 7–10 years for a diagnosis. In that time the disease can spread, fertility can be affected, and pain becomes chronic — all while symptoms are dismissed as 'just bad periods'.
body.da: Den gennemsnitlige kvinde venter 7–10 år på en diagnose. I den tid kan sygdommen sprede sig, fertiliteten påvirkes, og smerten blive kronisk — alt imens symptomerne affærdiges som 'bare kraftige menstruationer'.

title.da: Smerte der ikke bliver taget alvorligt

body.en: Research repeatedly shows that women's pain is reported less credibly and treated less aggressively than men's. For endometriosis patients this compounds into years of birth-control prescriptions without imaging, and emergency visits dismissed as anxiety.
body.da: Forskning viser gentagne gange, at kvinders smerte bliver tillagt mindre troværdighed og behandlet mindre aggressivt end mænds. For endometriosepatienter betyder det år med p-pille-recepter uden billeddiagnostik, og akutbesøg der affærdiges som angst.

problems.source: Chen et al. 2008 (analgesic disparity) · patient surveys

body.en: Endometriosis affects roughly as many women as diabetes affects people — yet it receives a fraction of the research funding. The result: no cure, no non-invasive diagnostic standard, and treatments that haven't fundamentally changed in decades.
body.da: Endometriose rammer omtrent lige så mange kvinder, som diabetes rammer mennesker — men sygdommen modtager en brøkdel af forskningsmidlerne. Resultatet: ingen kur, ingen ikke-invasiv diagnostisk standard, og behandlinger der ikke har ændret sig grundlæggende i årtier.

body.en: Current options are hormonal suppression, pain management and surgery. They help many — but recurrence is common and quality of life remains impaired for millions. Non-hormonal therapies are finally entering late-stage trials (see the live dashboard).
body.da: Nuværende muligheder er hormonel dæmpning, smertelindring og kirurgi. Det hjælper mange — men tilbagefald er hyppige, og livskvaliteten er fortsat nedsat for millioner. Ikke-hormonelle behandlinger er endelig på vej i sene kliniske faser (se live-dashboardet).

body.en: Free digital mindfulness- and acceptance-based self-management programme for endometriosis pain, run by Aarhus University Hospital together with the Danish patient organisation. Recruiting now.
body.da: Gratis digitalt mindfulness- og acceptance-baseret selv-håndteringsprogram mod endometriosesmerter, drevet af Aarhus Universitetshospital sammen med den danske patientforening. Rekrutterer lige nu.

body.en: Denmark's patient organisation: phone counselling (also for relatives), closed support groups, free legal advice on your rights at work and in the system. 450 DKK/year.
body.da: Danmarks patientforening: telefonrådgivning (også for pårørende), lukkede støttegrupper, gratis juridisk rådgivning om dine rettigheder på arbejde og i systemet. 450 kr./år.

title.en: Know your right to a specialist centre
title.da: Kend din ret til et specialiseret center

body.en: In Denmark, patients with severe or complex endometriosis have the right to referral to one of two national centres: Rigshospitalet (East) or Aarhus University Hospital, Skejby (West). A second opinion can change everything.
body.da: I Danmark har patienter med svær eller kompleks endometriose ret til henvisning til et af to landsdelscentre: Rigshospitalet (øst) eller AUH, Skejby (vest). En second opinion kan ændre alt.

body.en: Denmark has just earmarked 160M DKK for a National Centre for Women's Health Research. Write to your regional council and MPs: endometriosis deserves a share — and a national diagnostic-delay target.
body.da: Danmark har netop afsat 160 mio. kr. til et Nationalt Center for Forskning i Kvinders Sundhed. Skriv til dit regionsråd og dine folketingskandidater: endometriose fortjener en del af midlerne — og et nationalt mål for diagnoseforsinkelse.

title.en: Send the one-pager to your politicians

body.en: A one-page, source-backed fact sheet for regional councils and MP candidates — including the 13 September deadline for the 160M DKK women's health research centre and three questions worth asking.
body.da: En one-page, kildebaseret fact-side til regionsråd og folketingskandidater — inkl. 13. september-fristen for de 160 mio. kr. til kvinders sundhed og tre spørgsmål værd at stille.

body.en: WERF, the Endometriosis Foundation of America and EndoFound fund research and awareness worldwide. Every contribution counts — and open data projects like this one are free to reuse.
body.da: WERF, Endometriosis Foundation of America og EndoFound finansierer forskning og oplysning verden over. Hvert bidrag tæller — og åbne data-projekter som dette er frit at genbruge.

methodology.en: Data is pulled automatically every week from the ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 and PubMed E-utilities, and committed to this repository as open JSON. Editorial content is curated with sources. This project is independent, non-commercial and not affiliated with any organisation. It is research and advocacy — not medical advice. Always discuss treatment choices with a specialist.
methodology.da: Data trækkes automatisk hver uge fra ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 og PubMed E-utilities og gemmes i dette repository som åben JSON. Redaktionelt indhold er kurateret med kilder. Projektet er uafhængigt, non-kommercielt og ikke tilknyttet nogen organisation. Det er research og advocacy — ikke lægefaglig rådgivning. Behandlingsvalg skal altid ske med en speciallæge.
